title: Embedded Picture TN in the Sentence

illustrates.quote: Many texts use pictures in exercises. An embedded transcriber’s note (TN) with a brief description is used in material that is partially or totally pictures.

items.text: The [picture of a butterfly] flew south for the winter.

print.printFeatures: A small inline illustration of a butterfly sits in place of the word "butterfly".
